name: report
notes: Re-baselined 2026-10-07 to migrations through 20261006000021 (v2). v1 described 0001-0012.
Wire enum values are snake_case (wrong_phone_number); Dart ReportReason.name is camelCase (wrongPhoneNumber). The adapter must convert both ways (phase-014 #1).

Direct INSERT on reports is revoked (20261006000013) and the anon insert policy dropped (20261006000018:196); the only path is submit_report, which sets status/source server-side, caps details at 1000 chars, normalizes the optional reporter phone and rate-limits per source and per listing.

submit_report returns a receipt {receiptId, status}, not a Report row; a repeat report from the same source within 24 h returns the same receipt. Dart submit() returns Future<Report>, so the adapter builds the Report locally from the receipt.

body.p_details: Number rings but the person says this is not a plumber (demo report).

error.description: Report against an id that does not exist or is not publicly listed. submit_report raises 'not_found: listing not found' (20261006000018:80-81), so unknown and hidden listings are indistinguishable (no FK probe).

error.message: Too many reports from this device; try again later.

wireBody.message: rate_limited: too many reports, try again later

otherErrors.description: submit_report raises 'rate_limited: ...' after 5 reports/hour or 20/day from one source, or 50/day against one listing (20261006000018:101-108).
